description: Karnataka State Skill Development Policy (2025–2032) aims to skill 3 million youth through an AI-led strategy designed to align training with global and domestic workforce demands.
body_lead: Karnataka will establish an AI-powered Skill Intelligence and Strategy Unit (KSISU) under the Karnataka Skill Development Authority (KSDA) as part of its new state Skill Development Policy (2025–2032). The seven-year policy outlines a Rs 4,432 crore investment plan to skill 3 million youth and position Karnataka as a global hub for a future-ready workforce. "This seven-year blueprint, backed by Rs 4,432 crore, aims to make Karnataka a global hub for a skilled and future-ready workforce.
